message.content:
**Uno – Game Rules Overview** **Objective** Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned by collecting the cards left in opponents’ hands when you finish a round. --- ### 1. Setup | Item | How it’s used | |------|---------------| | **Deck** | Standard Uno deck (108 cards: 4 colors × 25 cards + 8 special cards). | | **Players** | 2–10. | | **Deal** | Each player receives 7 cards. | | **Center pile** | Place the remaining deck face down; flip the top card to start the discard pile. | | **Starting player** | Player to the dealer’s left. | --- ### 2. Card Types | Color | Cards | Value | |-------|-------|-------| | Red, Green, Blue, Yellow | Numbers 0–9 | Face value | | Same colors | **Skip** | 20 pts | | Same colors | **Reverse** | 20 pts | | Same colors | **Draw Two** | 20 pts | | Wild | **Wild** | 50 pts | | Wild | **Wild Draw Four** | 50 pts | *Note:* The “0” card is unique per color; all other numbers appear twice. --- ### 3. Gameplay | Step | Action | |------|--------| | **Turn** | Play one card that matches either the color or the number of the top discard. | | **Special cards** | - **Skip**: Next player loses a turn.
- **Reverse**: Order of play reverses.
- **Draw Two**: Next player draws two cards and skips a turn.
- **Wild**: Player chooses new color.
- **Wild Draw Four**: Player chooses new color; next player draws four cards and skips a turn. | | **If you cannot play** | Draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately. | | **If you still cannot play** | Your turn ends. | --- ### 4. Winning a Round - When a player discards their last card, they shout **“Uno!”**. - If they forget and another player calls “Uno!” before the next player takes a turn, the forgetting player must draw two cards as a penalty. - The round ends when a player has no cards left. --- ### 5. Scoring | Card | Points | |------|--------| | Number cards | Face value | | Skip, Reverse, Draw Two | 20 pts | | Wild, Wild Draw Four | 50 pts | - Add up the points of all cards remaining in opponents’ hands. - The winner of the round receives those points. - Play continues until a player reaches the target score (commonly 500). --- ### 6. Variations & House Rules - **Stacking**: Some players allow stacking of Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards. - **No “Uno” rule**: Some groups skip the “Uno!” shout entirely. - **Custom scoring**: Adjust point values or target score for shorter/longer games. --- **Quick Tips** - Keep track of the current color and number to anticipate opponents’ moves. - Use Wild cards strategically to change the color when you’re stuck. - Remember to say “Uno!” when you have one card left to avoid penalties. Enjoy your game!
